job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic IoT Intern to join our team in Indore, specializing in Drone Technology. The ideal candidate should have 3+ years of experience or be a fresher with a strong foundation in computer science and engineering principles.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and test IoT solutions for drones, focusing on sensor integration and data processing.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate IoT devices with cloud services and mobile applications.


Develop and implement algorithms for real-time data processing and analysis using Python, C++, or other programming languages.


Conduct experiments and tests to validate the performance and reliability of IoT systems.


Troubleshoot issues and debug code to resolve problems efficiently.


Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in IoT technology, particularly in drone applications.




Job Requirements




Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.


Experience with programming languages such as Python, C++, Java, or similar.


Familiarity with embedded systems development, including microcontrollers and firmware development.


Knowledge of database management systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.


Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and develop creative solutions.


Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.




Additional Info



The selected candidate will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects involving cutting-edge technologies and contribute to the growth and innovation of the company.
